integrity: The proof and exact counting recurrence are explicit, finite verification is reproducible but is not a universal proof. Literature comparison is best-effort, not a formal publication-priority guarantee. No external independent verification has been completed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for signed unit-weight stars and unrestricted unilateral Nash deviations; the random law assumes independent fair leaf preferences and edgewise reciprocity. Not claimed for other graph topologies, general weights, other consent rules, or correlated different edges.
title: An exact Nash-stability spectrum and reciprocity transition on signed stars
